judged_text: The decrypted credential payload is persisted (app-credential.ts:44-50) without validating it against the target app's zod schema (googleCredentialSchema, O365AuthCredentials, etc.), so parent-app payload drift surfaces as TypeErrors deep inside booking flows instead of being caught at the boundary.

adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), the decrypted `keys` are `JSON.parse(...)`d and then persisted directly via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: keys } })` / `create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })` with no validation against any app-specific zod schema (only the outer request body is validated). The diff shows many integrations relying on zod-parsed credential shapes elsewhere (e.g., `googleCredentialSchema`, O365 token schemas), so storing arbitrary/unvalidated payloads here can later break consumers that assume a specific structure.
